reference.code: public final class Solution { public static byte[] decodeHex(String s){if((s.length()&1)!=0)return null;byte[]o=new byte[s.length()/2];for(int i=0;i<o.length;i++){int a=Character.digit(s.charAt(2*i),16),b=Character.digit(s.charAt(2*i+1),16);if(a<0||b<0||s.charAt(2*i)>127||s.charAt(2*i+1)>127)return null;o[i]=(byte)(a*16+b);}return o;} }
